readings.Aries: You can start over. You've done it before. The question is whether that's what this requires. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Taurus: Your senses are your instruments. When did you last use them on something purely for enjoyment? Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Gemini: The distraction is real and deliberate. You know what you're distracting yourself from. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Cancer: You withdraw when hurt in a way that looks like peace. The people who care about you can see the difference. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: Your instinct to protect your reputation is understandable. It is occasionally more expensive than the alternative. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Virgo: Your care for the people around you is expressed in actions, not words. Make sure they know it. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Libra: The peace in the room is yours. You made it. Today someone else can tend it. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: You are drawn to what frightens you. This is why you understand things others don't. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more attached to the journey than to the destination, which is beautiful and occasionally inconvenient. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Capricorn: There is warmth in you that your efficiency sometimes buries. Let it surface. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Aquarius: Something you know in theory is asking to become something you know in practice. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Pisces: The mood that comes in like water recedes like water too. Stay with it until it does. Saying less will move this further than saying more.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing gibbous: more than half lit and growing. The Moon is also moving ~3.8 cm further from Earth every year — budget accordingly.
Mars and Jupiter are within 1.7° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
